rationale: X has a distinctive condensed serif headline with an italic accent, a drafting-sheet hero with annotated U-values and a data strip, and a bold black metrics band, so it reads as an architect's own site. Y is competent and cohesive, with a good annotated elevation and a green band. Its serif headline, card grid and dark-green pricing card follow a more familiar premium-template pattern, and its hero headline is long and heavy.
